notes.title: Dreamhouse: The Game Announcement and Social Media
notes.content:
Welcome Architects!

DeSand Game Studios is happy to announce and show to the community:
Dreamhouse: The Game

We aim to create a place where Players can unleash their inner Architects and allow them to create their very own houses from dreams - together! Experience the process of creating houses like never before in a photo-realistic Unreal Engine 5 game that feature:


Multiplayer/online co-op mode – Build Dreams together!
Different surroundings - cabin in a forest, a house in the mountains, hacienda on a beach
Unique mechanics - import real objects & export real home projects to use in real life
Community – You created something fabulous? Let people rate it and compete in Leaderboard!
Photo mode – Capture Your Genius and share it! Make people wonder if it's a real-life photo!
VR - Dive into the world of Dreamhouse!

Join our growing community of Architects on Social Media, Discord Server and add 
Dreamhouse: The Game to Your Wishlist to stay informed! 

Your DeSand team
